knowledge:
- key_parameters: factdir=Full path of the directory containing files corresponding to various cell lines in .bed format ;; annofile=Full path of the annotation file (e.g., exons, TSSs, genes) in .bed format ;; annolist=Name of full set or subset of the entries in the annotation file ;; group_names=A vector containing the user-defined names of the groups to be created ;; grouping_factor=Name of the assay/modality on which grouping will be done (e.g., "CAGE") ;; comparison=A vector of comparison symbols such as >, <, ==, >=, <=, %in% ;; condition=A vector of conditions corresponding to comparison ;; choice=Numeric or character choice determining the type of plot/analysis in descriptor(), chart_correlation(), analyse_variables(), analyse_individuals(), analyse_integrated_variables(), analyse_integrated_individuals(), and cluster() ;; integrated=Logical in extract() indicating whether to extract from integrated (TRUE) or non-integrated (FALSE) assays ;; exclude=List of columns to exclude from each assay during integration ;; mergetype=Numeric (1 or 2) in integrate_pca() indicating whether to run PCA on selected groups (1) or all individuals (2)
- alternatives: Regression-based joint modeling (Huang, 2014) is preferred when labeled classes (e.g., disease vs control) are available. Unsupervised qualitative Gaussian process models (Ha et al., 2017) are preferred when qualitative (binary) integration is sufficient. Kernel or graph-based methods (Lanckriet et al., 2004; Wang et al., 2014) are preferred for building common similarity networks between samples, though they lack interpretability.
- when_to_use: Use when you have multiple heterogeneous omics assays across different or partially overlapping cell lines/conditions, and you want to analyze the source of variation, integrate them quantitatively, and cluster genomic features (e.g., TSSs, genes) based on their consolidated multi-omics state.
- pitfalls: create_group() requires that one group name should be used only once in the groups argument. plot_density() requires that the groups argument should not contain a value that is not used in integrate_variables(). plot_density_3D() calculates 2D density using kde2d from MASS; if the variance on either or both PCs is 0, KDE cannot be calculated. integrate_pca() requires that the length of the exclude list must be equal to the number of assays (use 0 if no columns are excluded). cluster_parameters() uses clValid and NbClust, which take huge memory and CPU for a high number of samples; it is highly recommended to use a subset of original data (using the rand argument in extract()).

workflows.name: single_assay_analysis
workflows.intent: Prepare genomic feature datasets from BED files, group them by expression/activity, perform EDA, and integrate cell lines/conditions using PCA for individual assays.
input: factdir (directory containing BED files for each cell line/condition of an assay)
annolist.txt (text file containing a list of annotation IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare dataset from BED files using prepare_dataset() ;; 2. Create a MultiAssayExperiment object ;; 3. Subgroup genomic features based on a grouping factor using create_group() ;; 4. Perform exploratory data analysis using descriptor() and chart_correlation() ;; 5. Integrate cell lines/variables for individual assays using integrate_variables() ;; 6. Analyze single-assay PCA results using analyse_variables(), analyse_individuals(), plot_density(), and plot_density_3D()
workflows.code:
all_cells <- prepare_dataset(factdir = fact, annofile = anno, annolist = list)
library(MultiAssayExperiment)
assaylist <- list("demofactor" = all_cells)
demoMultiAssay <- MultiAssayExperiment(experiments = assaylist)
groupinfo <- create_group(name = multi_assay, group_names = c("WE" , "RE" ,"NE" ,"IntE"), grouping_factor = "CAGE", comparison = c(">=" ,"%in%" ,"==" ,"%in%"), condition = c("25" ,"1:5" ,"0" ,"6:24"))
descriptor(name = multi_assay, factors = c("H2az", "H3k4me1","H3k9ac"), groups = c("WE","RE"), choice = 1, title = "Distribution of percentage of cell types overlapping with various factors", groupinfo = groupinfo)
descriptor(name = multi_assay, factors = c("H2az", "H3k4me1","H3k9ac"), groups = c("WE","RE"), choice = 2, choice2group = "WE", title = "Distribution of percentage of cell types overlapping with a factor in various combinations of epigenetic marks in the selected group", groupinfo = groupinfo)
chart_correlation(name = multi_assay, Assay = "H2az", groups = "WE", choice = "scatter", groupinfo = groupinfo)
chart_correlation(name = multi_assay, Assay = "H2az", groups = "WE", choice = "table", groupinfo = groupinfo)
chart_correlation(name = multi_assay, Assay = "H2az", groups = "WE", choice = "hist", bins = 10, groupinfo = groupinfo)
chart_correlation(name = multi_assay, Assay = "H2az", groups = "WE", choice = "all", groupinfo = groupinfo)
PCAlist <- integrate_variables(Assays = c("H2az","H3k4me1", "H3k9ac"), name = multi_assay, groups = c("WE","RE", "NE", "IntE"), groupinfo = groupinfo, scale.unit = FALSE, graph = FALSE)
analyse_variables(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H2az", choice = 1, title = "variance barplot", addlabels = TRUE)
analyse_variables(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H3k4me1",choice = 2, title = "Loadings of cell lines on PC1 and PC2", xlab = "PCs")
analyse_variables(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H2az", choice = 3,title = "Correlation matrix", xlab = "PCs")
analyse_variables(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H2az", choice = 4,PC = 1, title = "Squarred loadings of Cell lines on PC1")
analyse_variables(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H2az", choice = 5,PC=1, title = "Contribution of Cell lines on PC1")
analyse_variables(name = PCAlist, Assay = c("H3k9ac","H2az", "H3k4me1"), choice = 6)
analyse_individuals(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H3k9ac", groupinfo = groupinfo, choice = 1, PC = c(1,2))
selected <- analyse_individuals(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H3k4me1", choice = 1, PC = c(1,2), select.ind = list(contrib = 100), groupinfo = groupinfo)
plot(selected)
analyse_individuals(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H3k9ac", choice = 2, PC = c(1,2,3), col = c("RED", "BLACK"), groupinfo = groupinfo)
densityplot <- plot_density(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H2az", groupinfo = groupinfo, PC = 1, groups = c("WE","RE","IntE"), adjust = 1)
plot_density_3D(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H2az", group = "WE", PC1 = 1,PC2 = 2, grid_size = 100, groupinfo = groupinfo, static = FALSE)
plot_density_3D(name = PCAlist, Assay = "H2az", group = "WE", groupinfo = groupinfo, PC1 = 1,PC2 = 2, grid_size = 100, static = TRUE, theta = -50, phi = 40, box = TRUE, shade = 0.1, ticktype = "detailed", d = 10)

workflows.name: multi_assay_integration_and_clustering
workflows.intent: Integrate multiple distinct omics assays, analyze the integrated multi-omics space, determine optimal clustering parameters, and cluster genomic features.
workflows.stages: 1. Integrate multiple assays using integrate_pca() ;; 2. Analyze integrated variables and individuals using analyse_integrated_variables() and analyse_integrated_individuals() ;; 3. Perform density analysis on integrated data using plot_integrated_density() and plot_integrated_density_3D() ;; 4. Extract PCA data for clustering using extract() ;; 5. Determine optimal cluster parameters using cluster_parameters() ;; 6. Cluster genomic features using cluster() ;; 7. Validate clusters and identify misclassified points using daisy() and silhouette() ;; 8. Explore cluster characteristics using cluster_boxplot()
workflows.code:
exclude <- list(0,c(1,9))
int_PCA <- integrate_pca(Assays = c("H2az", "H3k9ac"), groupinfo = groupinfo, name = multi_assay, mergetype = 2, exclude = exclude, graph = FALSE)
start_end = int_PCA$start_end
name = int_PCA$int_PCA
analyse_integrated_variables(start_end = start_end, name = name, choice = 1, title = "variance barplot", Assay = 1, addlabels = TRUE)
analyse_integrated_variables(start_end = start_end, Assay = 1, name = name, choice = 2 , title = "Loadings of cell lines on PC1 and PC2", var_type = "contrib")
analyse_integrated_variables(start_end = start_end, Assay = 1, name = name, choice = 3, title = "Correlation of Cell lines with PCs of integrated Assays", is.cor = TRUE)
analyse_integrated_variables(start_end = start_end, Assay = 1, name = name, choice = 4, PC = 1, title = "Squarred loadings of Cell lines on PC1 of integrated Assays")
analyse_integrated_variables(start_end = start_end, Assay = 1, name = name, choice = 5, PC=1, title = "Contribution of Cell lines on PC1 of integrated Assays")
analyse_integrated_individuals(name = name, choice = 1, PC = c(1,2), groupinfo = groupinfo)
analyse_integrated_individuals(name = name, choice = 2, PC = c(1,2,3), col = c("RED", "BLACK","GREEN"), groupinfo = groupinfo)
densityplot <- plot_integrated_density(name = name, PC = 1, groups = c("WE","RE","IntE","NE"), groupinfo = groupinfo)
plot_integrated_density_3D(name = name, PC1 = 1, PC2 = 2, group = c("RE","RE"), gridsize = 100, static = TRUE, groupinfo = groupinfo)
plot_integrated_density_3D(name = name, PC1 = 1, PC2 = 2, group = c("WE","RE"), gridsize = 100, static = FALSE, groupinfo = groupinfo)
data <- extract(name = name, PC = c(1:4), groups = c("WE","RE"), integrated = TRUE, rand = 600, groupinfo = groupinfo)
clusterstats <- cluster_parameters(name = data, optimal = FALSE, n = 2:6, comparisonAlgorithm = "clValid", distance = "euclidean", clusteringMethods = c("kmeans","pam"), validationMethods = c("internal","stability"))
clusterstats <- cluster_parameters(name = data, n = 2:6, comparisonAlgorithm = "NbClust", distance = "euclidean", clusteringMethods = "kmeans", validationMethods = "all")
library(factoextra)
fviz_nbclust(clusterstats, method = c("silhouette", "wss", "gap_stat"))
data <- extract(name = name, PC = c(1:4), groups = c("WE","RE"), integrated = TRUE, rand = 1000, groupinfo = groupinfo)
clusters <- cluster(name = data, n = 2, choice = "kmeans", title = "kmeans on 2 clusters")
print(clusters$plot)
clustered_data <- cbind(data,clusters$cluster$cluster)
clusters <- cluster(name = data, choice = "density", eps = 2, MinPts = 100, graph = TRUE, title = "eps = 1 and MinPts = 1.5")
print(clusters$plot)
clustered_data <- as.data.frame(cbind(data,clusters$cluster$cluster))
clustered_data <- clustered_data[clustered_data$V5 != 0, ]
library(cluster)
dist <- daisy(data)
sil = silhouette(clusters$cluster$cluster,dist)
misclassified <- which(sil[,3] < 0)
head(sil[misclassified,])
data[misclassified[3:7],]
bp <- cluster_boxplot(name = multi_assay, Assay = "H2az", clusterobject = clustered_data, clustercolumn = 5)
